integrity: The proof uses the source's own positive tail constant and strict moment-existence theorem. The full open-access PDF was inspected at the tail theorem, moment corollary, boundary prose, and Table 1. The included numerical checker verifies only the tail normalization; the infinite-moment conclusion is analytic.
scientific_limitations: The finding addresses moment existence and four affected Table 1 rows, not the paper's estimation or application results.
It does not recompute numerical table values in parameter regimes where the relevant moments exist.
No finite-part regularization of the logarithmically divergent boundary moment is proposed.
title: The GGWP critical second-moment boundary invalidates four Table 1 rows
